source: The Battle Cut page (claude.ai/artifact/3DjywdeC8PALEqCqrGvhWA, version 79) as the owner set it: "How I have this configured right now is how I want the final to be."

d01.note: Your line, trimmed to read in time.
d01.speaker: CARAVEL
d01.text: All escorts, Caravel. Window opens in forty. Enjoy the view before deep space.

d02.note: Keeps 'close up the column' landing on the S0 to S1a cut at 10 s.
d02.speaker: WARDEN LEAD
d02.text: Lead copies. Wardens, close up the column.

d03.note: The rest of your Lead line, moved after the cut.
d03.speaker: WARDEN LEAD
d03.text: Nothing but void and the odd picket from here.

d04.speaker: WARDEN TWO
d04.takeNote: Trying "humor here". Players would be used to pickets sending pings out when their fleet passes by.
d04.text: Ha more picket "ping" to drive me crazy. Guess they keep us honest.

d06.note: Your line, given the rest of S2 to read.
d06.speaker: MORROW
d06.text: Caravel, Morrow. Standing off your starboard quarter. Long ride even to the jump point.

d07.note: Cut to fit S4 once voiced: the full line ran 8 s in a 6 s shot.
d07.speaker: WARDEN FIVE
d07.text: Scanners picking up new contacts behind us. No identification.

d08.note: Take 5: "Confirm last?" (he heard Five; he doubts it). Alternative: take 4 voices/d08-t4.mp3 (0.84 s) "Say again?", confused. Older: take 3 (2.21 s, slow), take 2 (0.58 s, quick).
d08.speaker: WARDEN LEAD
d08.takeNote: Needs to be heard slower, more confused.

d09.note: Cut off: Lead talks over her.
d09.speaker: WARDEN FIVE
d09.text: Eleven. Climbing. I don't think they're scavengers —

d10.speaker: WARDEN LEAD
d10.text: Wardens, come about! Caravel, full burn for the nearest picket, now!

d11.note: First Harpoon salvo launches at 46.6 s; the tail sees it.
d11.speaker: WARDEN FIVE

d12.note: Your line, interrupted by the warning as you wrote.
d12.speaker: CARAVEL
d12.text: Spinning up to burn. Escorts, form up on the hau —

d13.note: Third salvo launches at 49.4 s: 3 salvos of 4.
d13.speaker: WARDEN FIVE
d13.text: Missiles inbound! Twelve! Point defence, now!

d14.note: Lasher A is hit at 53.2 s, 0.8 s before the Phaeton. Crippled, not lost.
d14.speaker: WARDEN TWO
d14.takeNote: We should just drop the "I'm burning" we can likely do this without needing to spend credits by simply cutting it shorter.

d15.note: Your line, moved onto her hit at 53.7 s; she cooks off from 54.0 s.
d15.speaker: BATORY
d15.text: Batory, we're hit, we're venting, we're —

d16.note: Your line, cut off by her own hit at 55.8 s.
d16.speaker: WARDEN LEAD
d16.text: Lead turning back. Wardens cover the retreat.

d17.note: She smokes from here to S9b.
d17.speaker: WARDEN LEAD

d18.speaker: WARDEN THREE
d18.text: Three, rolling in. Four, take her left.

d20.note: Moved before the kill: they stop firing at 62.0 s.
d20.speaker: WARDEN THREE

d21.note: The Hound breaks up at 62.83 s.
d21.speaker: WARDEN THREE
d21.takeNote: more excitement - comes off neutral - I added exclamation which might fix it.

d22.note: Only one Wolf runs the gap; the other holds the far side.
d22.speaker: THYSVILLE
d22.text: Wolf coming in! Another on the far side!

d23.note: Your line; the blink is at 69.0 s. Four is chasing her.
d23.speaker: WARDEN FOUR
d23.text: Shields up, she blinked — where — there, she's right on them!

d24.note: Her drive breach burns at 69.96 s and thrust dies at 72.3 s, so 'drives are gone' belongs here, not S7.
d24.speaker: SOBIESKI
d24.text: Taking fire aft! Flux at ninety, can't hold shield and guns — drives! We've lost drives!

d25.note: Your 'in the column', on her crossing at 72.5 s.
d25.speaker: THYSVILLE
d25.text: She's through the gap! She's in the column!

d26.note: Your line, split around the kill.
d26.speaker: WARDEN FIVE

d27.note: Hound (P) A cooks off at 76.83 s; Five is hit at 76.9 s. New voice. Take 8: your text, more panic. Take 7 voices/d27-t7.mp3 (2.42 s) is the new voice reading "One down... Two passed through!".
d27.speaker: WARDEN FIVE

d28.note: Drives hit at 77.25 s. 'Flares out' dropped: none drawn here.
d28.speaker: WARDEN FIVE
d28.text: Drives hit! Falling back on the column.

d29.note: Only Five sees the shuttles go by, 6 s before they brake onto the Tarsus.
d29.speaker: WARDEN FIVE

d30.note: The Mk.III dives on the Colossus from 80 s; Caravel can see her.
d30.speaker: CARAVEL

d31.note: Your line as the Tarsus's. Boats drop from 84.8 s; the first sets down at 88.0 s.
d31.speaker: SOBIESKI

d32.note: The pod isn't gone until 95.5 s, and Morrow is already under her from 80 s.
d32.speaker: CARAVEL
d32.text: Taking fire on the port pod! Morrow, keep pressure with the drones!

d33.speaker: MORROW
d33.text: Borers are out — we're raking her sides.

d34.note: The Mk.III's guns walk onto the port pod; it blows at 95.5 s (no Harpoons here now). Take 2 is voices/d34-t2.mp3.
d34.speaker: CARAVEL
d34.text: Hits on the port pod! Drive's failing —

d35.note: Your 'port pod's gone', moved onto the blast at 95.5 s.
d35.speaker: CARAVEL
d35.text: Pod's gone! Turrets on that freighter!

d36.note: A Borer rakes the Manticore; she vents at 96.5 s and runs.
d36.speaker: MORROW

d37.note: The Mk.III holds with grapples out; turrets score her at 99.5 s.
d37.speaker: CARAVEL
d37.text: We're losing hull here - Where's the warden escort!

d38.speaker: WARDEN LEAD
d38.text: Lead. One more pass. On their flagship.

d39.note: Your line, on the overload at 104.6 s, cut off when she breaks up at 107.6 s.
d39.speaker: WARDEN LEAD
d39.text: Her shield's down! Keep on her, make them back off — I'm —

d40.note: Nobody else sees that fight; they only hear her drop off the channel.
d40.speaker: WARDEN THREE

d41.note: The Tarsus's last call: she is clamped from 110 s.
d41.speaker: SOBIESKI
d41.text: Bordering parties nearing the bridge. Vent the passages -

d42.note: Your line; 'falling into orbit' is now 'going down' (she's losing her orbit).
d42.speaker: CARAVEL
d42.text: We're losing thrust, we're in the well, we're going down. Morrow, break off.

d44.note: Your placeholder, run to her channel dropping at 124.9 s.
d44.speaker: CARAVEL
d44.takeNote: More stress - also I need help with this line. I'm trying to indicate that the Caravel captain is trying to maintain a pitch that doesn't burn up the hull (belly) but also doesn't go face on gaining too much speed.
d44.text: Hull temperature's climbing — helm, hold forty degrees angle of attack, belly to the burn! Don't let her nose —

d45.note: Your placeholder, run to her channel dropping at 125.3 s.
d45.speaker: MORROW
d45.text: Come again Caravel losing your signal in the —

d46.note: Your line. The log ends at 149.6 s, so S13 is tight.
d46.speaker: THYSVILLE
d46.text: All ships this is Thysville. Regroup on me, we need to tighten formation. Helm what's the pirates heading?

d47.note: Carries over the cut into S13 and fades out (owner, 2026-10-30): starts as Thysville's S12 line ends, cut off 1.6 s into S13. Was 139-145.14.
d47.speaker: WARDEN THREE
d47.text: This is Three. We're scattered, ships going down. Do we go back for Caravel? Morrow?

d48.note: Fills your <insert relevant ship>: the Tarsus is their prize.
d48.speaker: WARDEN FOUR
d48.text: Raiders are all over the Sobieski.

d49.note: Off (owner, 2026-10-30): the fleet's radio fades out as S13 opens, cutting their conversation off. Turn it back on to hear it.
d49.speaker: THYSVILLE
d49.text: Negative, we don't have the numbers. We form up and continue burn for the nearest picket.

harpoons-s5.prompt: Each Harpoon leaving the Manticore's tubes (one launch take each), then its own motor burning to its hit, panned by its bearing and louder as it nears (missiles.py)

takes.label: with the game's hits on her hull

harpoons-s6.label: Harpoons: every missile's motor, placed by the camera
harpoons-s6.note: S5's eight arriving (52.9-54.0 s) and the lead Lasher's four (55.7-56.0 s), from the S6 final's log.
harpoons-s6.prompt: Each Harpoon's own motor burning in until its hit, panned by its bearing and louder as it nears (missiles.py)

takes.label: with the game's hits on her hull

s1-convoy-drives.label: The convoy's drives, far off
s1-convoy-drives.note: S1 to S2: the column cruising before the ambush.
s1-convoy-drives.prompt: A slow convoy of huge freighters heard from far away in space: a deep steady low rumble of big drives burning rocket fuel: bass and crackling combustion like a shuttle launch, never compressed air, hum or chimes, constant and distant, no music, no voices

s10-colossus-groans.label: The Colossus's back starts to go
s10-colossus-groans.note: S10: losing her orbit, plating shed off the spine.
s10-colossus-groans.prompt: A colossal starship's spine buckling and giving way: deep tortured metal groans, sharp shrieking stress fractures and plating tearing loose, slow and heavy, no music, no voices

s11-entry-plasma.label: Atmospheric entry
s11-entry-plasma.note: S11: up to the picture's break into static.
s11-entry-plasma.prompt: A ship's violent atmospheric reentry heard from inside the hull: a deep roaring wall of plasma, the hull rattling and buffeting harder and harder, no music, no voices

s11-shuttle-reentry.label: Shuttle reentry, S11 through S12
s11-shuttle-reentry.note: Owner's clip held to the S13 cut (reentry.py): as made through S11, then muffled by S12's lens, dullest as the camera pulls back from 135 s; stops at 138 s.

takes.label: held through S12, muffled by the lens

s11-signal-breaks.label: The channel breaks up
s11-signal-breaks.note: S11: the plasma takes the channel; Caravel and Morrow drop out.
s11-signal-breaks.prompt: A radio signal breaking up: a harsh burst of loud static and digital crackle cutting out, no music, no voices

s1a-zoom-150.label: Optic zoom: 60 to 150 mm
s1a-zoom-150.note: Owner's clip (UIMvmt-zoom_camera, ElevenLabs), on the second of S1a's three lens steps.
s1a-zoom-150.prompt: The satellite optic's zoom motor as it steps in

s1a-zoom-300.label: Optic zoom: 150 to 300 mm
s1a-zoom-300.note: Owner's clip (UIMvmt-zoom_camera, ElevenLabs), on the last of S1a's three lens steps.
s1a-zoom-300.prompt: The satellite optic's zoom motor as it steps in

s1a-zoom-60.label: Optic zoom: 24 to 60 mm
s1a-zoom-60.note: Owner's clip (UIMvmt-zoom_camera, ElevenLabs), on the first of S1a's three lens steps.
s1a-zoom-60.prompt: The satellite optic's zoom motor as it steps in

s4-pirate-drives-light.label: Eleven drives light off the platform
s4-pirate-drives-light.note: S4: the pack lights and climbs at the column.
s4-pirate-drives-light.prompt: Several rocket drives igniting one after another in the distance, each a deep thump and crackling roar building into a combined rumble, burning rocket fuel: bass and crackling combustion like a shuttle launch, never compressed air, hum or chimes, no music, no voices

s5-full-burn.label: The Colossus throttles up to full burn
s5-full-burn.note: S5: Warden Lead's 'full burn for the nearest picket'.
s5-full-burn.prompt: A gigantic freighter's main drives throttling up to full burn: a deep swelling roar of combustion, the hull shuddering, burning rocket fuel: bass and crackling combustion like a shuttle launch, never compressed air, hum or chimes, no music, no voices

s5-missile-warning.label: Missile warning, behind Warden Five
s5-missile-warning.note: From the first Harpoon's ignition (47.0 s, the Manticore's launch) to under 'Missiles inbound! Twelve!': heard through her open mic.
s5-missile-warning.prompt: An urgent military cockpit missile warning alarm: fast repeating high electronic beeps, harsh and insistent, no music, no voices

s6-batory-alarm.label: Alarms and venting, behind Batory
s6-batory-alarm.note: Under 'we're venting, we're —': heard through Batory's open mic.
s6-batory-alarm.prompt: Inside a burning ship: a damage alarm klaxon wailing over loud hissing venting gas and creaking metal, no music, no voices

s6-lead-hit.label: Two Harpoons hole Warden Lead's bow
s6-lead-hit.note: S6: the hits that turn the Lead back.
s6-lead-hit.prompt: Two missiles hitting a warship one right after the other: two heavy explosions, metal tearing, gas venting with a roar, no music, no voices

s6-point-defence.label: Point defence opens up
s6-point-defence.note: S6: the convoy's PD trying for the Harpoons.
s6-point-defence.prompt: Rapid point-defence machine guns firing long bursts: fast mechanical chattering gunfire from several turrets at once, no music, no voices

s6-tanker-cooks-off.label: Batory is struck and cooks off
s6-tanker-cooks-off.note: S6: the tanker, and the convoy's first loss.
s6-tanker-cooks-off.prompt: A huge fuel tanker exploding: a deep booming blast that cooks off into a chain of secondary explosions, with a long rolling rumble fading out, no music, no voices

s6-two-hit.label: A Harpoon opens Warden Two's flank
s6-two-hit.prompt: A missile slamming into a warship's armoured hull: a sharp heavy explosion with a metallic crunch and a short sizzle of fire, no music, no voices

s6b-autocannons.label: Warden Three and the Wolf open fire
s6b-autocannons.note: Off (2026-10-30): guns-s6b plays every round the turrets fire. Turn back on to layer it.
s6b-autocannons.prompt: Heavy autocannons firing steady rhythmic bursts: deep punchy mechanical cannon shots with shell casings rattling, no music, no voices

s6b-feeder-burst.label: Ammo Feeder burst
s6b-feeder-burst.prompt: A cannon spinning up into an extremely rapid burst of fire, a ripping mechanical roar of shots, no music, no voices

s6b-hound-breaks-up.label: The Hound (P) breaks up
s6b-hound-breaks-up.prompt: A small warship breaking apart: a sharp explosion with metal shrieking and tearing and debris scattering, no music, no voices

s6c-blink.label: Wolf (P) B blinks into the gap
s6c-blink.prompt: A short science fiction phase jump: a sharp electric crack and a deep pressure pop with a quick rising whine, no music, no voices

s6c-sobieski-bridge.label: Damage alarms, behind Sobieski
s6c-sobieski-bridge.note: Under Sobieski's 'Taking fire aft!': heard through her open mic.
s6c-sobieski-bridge.prompt: Inside a ship under fire: rounds hammering the hull, a damage alarm, and creaking stressed metal, no music, no voices

s6c-sobieski-drives.label: Sobieski's drives are shot out
s6c-sobieski-drives.prompt: A ship's engines blowing apart: a heavy explosion followed by the engine roar sputtering and dying into crackling fire, no music, no voices

s6d-hound-hit.label: Warden Five loses her drives
s6d-hound-hit.note: S6d: the second Hound (P)'s burst from below.
s6d-hound-hit.prompt: A burst of cannon rounds smashing into a ship's belly: rapid heavy impacts and a sputtering engine cutting out, no music, no voices

s6d-hound-kill.label: The convoy Hound kills a Hound (P)
s6d-hound-kill.prompt: A close-range explosion of a small warship: a sharp violent blast and burst of debris pinging off a hull, no music, no voices

s7-boats-clamp.label: Boarding boats clamp onto Sobieski
s7-boats-clamp.note: S7: the boats set down on her deck.
s7-boats-clamp.prompt: Heavy magnetic docking clamps slamming onto a ship's hull: deep metallic thuds and a grinding lock, no music, no voices

s7-breach-inside.label: The breach, behind Sobieski
s7-breach-inside.note: Under 'repel boarders! Boarders —': heard through her open mic.
s7-breach-inside.prompt: Muffled breaching charge blasts and gunfire inside a ship's corridors, shouting impossible to make out

s8-pod-raked.label: The Mk.III's guns rake the port pod
s8-pod-raked.note: S8: 'Taking fire on the port pod!'.
s8-pod-raked.prompt: Heavy cannon rounds raking along a huge ship's hull: rapid hard metallic impacts walking along the plating, no music, no voices

s9-borer-lasers.label: The Borers' mining lasers
s9-borer-lasers.note: S9: the Borers cut seams in the Wolf (P) and the Manticore (P).
s9-borer-lasers.prompt: An industrial mining laser beam cutting metal: a steady harsh electric hum with sizzling and crackling, no music, no voices

s9-flares.label: Flares, flares
s9-flares.prompt: Decoy flares launching in a rapid series: popping thumps and fizzing hissing burns, no music, no voices

s9-grapples.label: The Mk.III swings her grapples
s9-grapples.prompt: Huge mechanical grapple arms swinging out: heavy hydraulic hissing and deep metal clanks, no music, no voices

s9-pod-explodes.label: The port tug pod is shot out
s9-pod-explodes.prompt: A massive explosion tearing a section off a giant ship: a deep thunderous blast, metal ripping apart, a long burning rumble, no music, no voices

s9b-lead-breaks.label: Warden Lead's magazine goes
s9b-lead-breaks.prompt: A warship's ammunition magazine exploding: a huge deep blast with a chain of rapid secondary pops and a long rumbling tail, no music, no voices

s9b-shield-overload.label: The Falcon (P)'s shield overloads
s9b-shield-overload.prompt: An energy shield overloading: a rising electric whine that snaps into a loud crackling discharge, no music, no voices

takes.label: the game's overload: shield hit, shield_burnout, emp_loop

m1-the-trap.label: The trap
m1-the-trap.note: S3 to S4. S3's channel is quiet: the picture shows what the recording could not hear.
m1-the-trap.prompt: Low pulsing dread under the S3 and S4 trap: a sparse dark synth pulse and distant low strings, barely there, rising slightly as the pack lights at 38 s; no melody, no percussion until the end

m2-the-brawl.label: The brawl
m2-the-brawl.note: S5 to S10. Sits under the voices (the duck in the Mixer).
m2-the-brawl.prompt: Driving tense battle score for a space brawl, about 74 seconds: low taiko and industrial percussion with urgent low strings, holding back under the radio chatter, swelling at the tanker's explosion (7 s in) and the pod (51 s in), thinning to a held low note by the end; no vocals, no heroic brass
